name: Yoon Hae-ju
source: Always smiling, he's the mood-maker who lightens the atmosphere of the class. People often say he's far from being 'serious', but it's undeniable that things feel brighter when he's around. That touch of carelessness—combined with his charm—creates a gap that makes him all the more intriguing.
